messages:
Lina (Docs): Heads-up — legal flagged several user-facing phrases in the SEA/LATAM residency docs. We need to: 1) clarify 'region' vs 'territory' labels, 2) update the SDK header snippet to show an explicit fallback header, and 3) add a short on-prem note for customers using Redwood Private. Can we coordinate a quick PR?
Alex K.: I can take the SDK snippet. Which header should we recommend? current header is `X-Redwood-Region` but we recently added `Prefer-Region` in the runtime for smart routing.
Lina (Docs): Use `Prefer-Region` as the primary sample, and show `X-Redwood-Region` as the explicit pin. Text: "Prefer-Region: sea-1 (routing preference) — fallback to X-Redwood-Region for strict pinning." Keep it two-line example.
Sam P.: Legal note: don't say "data never leaves region" — say "data is routed and stored according to residency controls". Also add a link to the residency policy: https://redwood.ai/legal/residency (we just updated it).
Jordan (DevRel): I'll test the Node/Go snippets against dedicated staging. Quick Node snippet I used:```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
await client.generate({ prompt: 'hi' , headers: { 'Prefer-Region': 'sea-1', 'X-Redwood-Region': 'sea-1' } });
```Test output: latency ~42ms to dedicated-staging-sea. Works. I'll paste sanitized logs in the PR.
Lina (Docs): Great. Also, please add a tiny on-prem blurb: "On Private deployments, region routing is controlled by customer network config; Redwood's control plane respects the customer's residency settings." Short and explicit.
Alex K.: PR branch ready: `docs/sea-latam-residency-snippet`. I added both curl and Node examples and a one-line CLI migration note: `redwoodctl config set region sea-1` Then doc-bot flagged a link mismatch for the on-prem page.
DocSync Bot: link-checker: broken link detected -> /docs/onprem/residency (404). Please update or add redirect.
Sam P.: I think the new onprem page moved under /docs/private/residency-guides. Update the link and add a footnote for enterprise customers about KMS/HSM controls.
Jordan (DevRel): Quick suggestion for microcopy: avoid the term "region enforcement" — use "residency controls". That's what legal prefers.
Lina (Docs): Good catch. I'll change all instances in the doc. Alex, can you include a short migration snippet for customers who previously used `--region` flag in older CLI? Example: `redwoodctl deploy --region=eu-west` -> `redwoodctl deploy --residency=eu-west` (one-liner explanation).
Alex K.: Added the CLI line and an automated test in the PR that checks the samples compile. Also included a tiny TOC anchor for "On-prem and Private".
DocSync Bot: PR check: sample-compile -> passed, link-check -> failed (1).
Alex K.: Fixing the link now. Also expanded the SDK example to show a three-tier fallback pattern: Prefer-Region (routing) -> X-Redwood-Region (pin) -> Accept-Region (legacy). Want me to include that?
Lina (Docs): Yes, but keep the example minimal. Maybe show the headers table and a one-sentence description of ordering.
Sam P.: Legal approves the new phrasing and the footnote for enterprise KMS. Adding :thumbsup:.
Jordan (DevRel): Once link is fixed, I'll run the quick integration in staging and sign off.
Lina (Docs): Timeline: Alex fixes link today, Jordan tests tomorrow, I merge after docs review. Thanks team :pray:
